instructions:
Inspect several row-units—especially at wing hinge points—checking for bent arms. If pivot is tight the arm should land squarely on the stop. If there is a lof of overhang on either side of the stop the arm is likely bent.
Bent arms can also be observed by noting the distance between the press wheel and closing wheel. This distance should be roughly the same across the board: any tighter or wider gaps indicate a bent arm.
